description:
Mental Reset | Sitar for an Overstimulated Mind | 1.5 Hours of Clear Calm

Too many tabs open — on your screen and in your head. Notifications, half-finished thoughts, the scroll that never ends. Your mind hasn't had a quiet minute all day.

This calm Indian instrumental music is designed to help an overstimulated mind put things down one at a time and come back to clear, unhurried ground.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm, clear sitar phrases blended with a steady tanpura drone and soft, distant tabla — unhurried melodies with real space between the notes.

Perfect for a midday mental reset, decluttering your head after too much screen time, studying, journaling, quiet work, an evening unwind, meditation, or slow deep breathing.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sitar — plucked strings with a warm, rounded, resonant tone
Raga: Madhuvanti — a clear, gently uplifting afternoon raga
Style: Slow Indian classical instrumental
Mood: Clear, calm, quietly refreshing
Atmosphere: Bright but unhurried — like a clean desk for the mind
Duration: 1.5 hours, uninterrupted

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it when your head feels crowded. Each time your attention gets pulled away, let the next sitar phrase bring it back. By the end, fewer tabs.
